name: Hololens 1.3.3 preview - Android ICU startup hotfix; device startup unverified
body:
Startup hotfix for the 1.3.2 preview: replaces JDK-only regex flags in WebsiteSearch that Android ICU rejects during startup. Keep your existing installation and app data; install this same-signer APK as an in-place update. Do not uninstall or clear app data.

Retains translated card-data updates with immediate browsing/scanner refresh, website-aligned card filters, primary Scan action with camera icon, 83 official characters/602 art options, and separate app-release notices. Future card/translation corrections use the user-confirmed data update channel. Artwork remains bundled; new hSD20/hSD21 battle effects are NOT enabled, and manual warnings remain. Original AI is available without login.

Preview limitations: physical-device startup, camera, Android JNI and dual-device PvP remain unverified. Optional ChatGPT official Android login/account eligibility and live inference remain unverified; no OAuth grant or inference usage was performed during development.

Checks: all 21 compiled search patterns plus 50 Unicode boundary cases pass native ICU validation; the original 1.3.2 pattern reproduces the failure. Host tests: 293/300 passed, seven unchanged Windows directory-channel failures, no new failures. All 69 ChatGPT tests pass offline. Android instrumentation compiles but was not executed. Release build and lint pass (0 errors/41 warnings). Original package/signer, v3 signature, 16 KiB alignment and unchanged assets/native libraries verified.
